name: De-AI-Prompt-Enhancer-Writer-Booster-SKILL
title_zh: 删掉AI腔，留下你人味的改写器
tagline_zh: 受够一眼假的“首先其次最后”和“赋能抓手”？它专挑AI高频词、排比腔、万能连接词下手，改完像你熬夜手写。
tagline_en: Tired of robotic 'firstly, moreover, in conclusion'? It hunts AI clichés, parallel structures, and filler.
why_zh: 不是简单换词，而是先标记AI指纹（如“不仅…而且”“总之”），再按你的语料风格重写。
why_en: It doesn't just swap synonyms—it flags AI fingerprints (e.g., 'not only... but also', 'in summary'), then rewrites using your.
limit_zh: 只处理英文文本，中文语料需自行翻译；不生成新内容，只改写已有段落；对刻意模仿AI风格的讽刺文可能误伤。
limit_en: English text only; Chinese requires pre-translation. No new content generation—rewrites only. May flag intentional AI-parody text. Needs ≥200 words.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: De-AI rewrite that keeps your human voice
